title: NASA SVS CGI Moon Kit — 2025 LROC WAC colour map, 16K
description: Equirectangular full-globe colour texture of the Moon built by NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio (Ernie Wright) from the LROC WAC 'Hapke Normalized' global mosaic plus an LOLA laser-altimeter albedo fill for the shadowed >70 deg latitudes. Explicitly designed as a 3D-rendering texture map.
credit: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio / Ernie Wright (USRA); data: LRO LROC WAC (NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University) and LRO LOLA
licence: NASA public domain; SVS asks for credit
notes: Probe: 206 image/tiff total=953573340 TIFF 16384x8192x3ch/16bit last-modified 2025-12-03. Page text: 'The map is centered on 0° longitude'; 'The source data covers the lunar globe from 70°N to 70°S' with poles filled from LOLA LDAM. Best single texture for a Three.js sphere. Page also offers 8K (243289792 B, verified) and 4K (page states 59.0 MB), plus a 2.4 GB full-size and a 942.8 MB EXR.

title: USGS Astrogeology — Moon LRO LROC WAC Global Morphology Mosaic 100 m
description: Global LRO Wide Angle Camera 643 nm morphology mosaic assembled by the USGS Astrogeology Science Center from WAC images acquired Nov 2009 – Feb 2011. Grayscale albedo/appearance mosaic of the whole Moon.
credit: NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University — LROC WAC; mosaic by USGS Astrogeology Science Center
notes: Probe: 206 image/tiff total=5959263751 BigTIFF (49492b00) 109164x54582x1ch/8bit. Page states '5.5 GB'. This is by far the highest-resolution full-globe LROC WAC mosaic I could verify with an anonymous direct URL — but it is grayscale, not colour, and the width is not a 2:1 multiple of the height, so the demo must handle the exact extent from the PDS/ISIS label rather than assuming 360x180.

title: USGS Astrogeology — Moon Clementine UVVIS 750 nm Global Mosaic 118 m
description: Global single-band (750 nm) Clementine UVVIS mosaic. Clean, low-contrast monochrome base map of the whole Moon from the 1994 NASA/DoD Clementine mission.
credit: NASA/JPL/USGS — Clementine UVVIS; mosaic by USGS Astrogeology Science Center
notes: Probe: 206 image/tiff total=4247470871 BigTIFF 92160x46080x1ch/8bit. Page states '4 GB'. Exact 2:1 ratio, so it maps 1:1 onto a 360x180 equirectangular sphere. Grayscale only; a colour companion is not served from this path.

title: USGS Astrogeology — Lunar Kaguya (SELENE) Terrain Camera Ortho Global Mosaic 474 m (64 ppd)
description: Near-global orthomosaic from the JAXA SELENE/Kaguya Terrain Camera (10 m/px source tiles, downsampled to 64 pixels per degree). Fills the resolution gap between LROC WAC and NAC and is especially valuable on the lunar farside.
credit: ©JAXA/SELENE — Kaguya Terrain Camera; mosaic by USGS Astrogeology Science Center
licence: JAXA terms of use; credit to JAXA and SELENE/Kaguya required (NOT simply public domain). The USGS page states: 'For use, refer to the JAXA Conditions for material usage page (http://jda.jaxa.jp/en/service.php) and please credit JAXA and the SELENE/Kaguya data. ©JAXA/SELENE' — and the page cites PDS/Kaguya documentation.
notes: Probe: 206 image/tiff total=530934601 23040x11520x1ch/16bit. The dataset page's raw HTML contains the exact anchor: href="https://planetarymaps.usgs.gov/mosaic/Lunar_Kaguya_TC_Ortho_Global_64ppd_v02.tif" download >Download (506 MB). PDS3 and ISIS3 .lbl labels are also served from the CKAN mirror.

title: NASA/JSC — S72-35970, 360-degree field of view of the Apollo 16 Descartes landing site
description: Genuine full 360-degree surround strip of the Apollo 16 Descartes landing site, assembled from individual frames of the colour RCA TV camera on the Lunar Roving Vehicle. Record has no '~large' variant, so ~orig is the only high-resolution copy.
credit: NASA/Johnson Space Center — Apollo 16 (LRV colour TV)
notes: Probe: 206 image/jpeg total=836393 JPEG 4372x1686. API description: 'A 360-degree field of view of the Apollo 16 Descartes landing site area composed of individual scenes taken from color transmission made by the color RCA TV camera mounted on the Lunar Roving Vehicle'. Resolution is low (TV-based) but the coverage really is 360 degrees — usable as an inner-cylinder backdrop.

title: LROC WAC Hapke-normalized mosaic — 3-band RGB equirectangular tile (70N-70S)
description: Photometrically normalized WAC colour mosaic from ~124,300 WAC images (2010-01-21 to 2013-05-01), archived as 8 equirectangular tiles per band and as 3-band 8-bit RGB (R=689 nm, G=415 nm, B=321 nm). This is the underlying data behind the SVS CGI Moon Kit colour map, in its native tiling.
projection: equirectangular (per tile), 400 m/pixel at the equator
format: PDS IMG + LBL (8 bit per band, 3 bands)
credit: NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University — LROC WAC; cite Sato et al. (2017), Icarus 296, 216-238
notes: Tile geometry read directly from the PDS label https://pds.lroc.asu.edu/data/LRO-L-LROC-5-RDR-V1.0/LROLRC_2001/DATA/MDR/WAC_HAPKE/WAC_HAPKE_3BAND_E350N0450.LBL (206, 3635 B): RECORD_BYTES=6841, FILE_RECORDS=5321, LINE_SAMPLES=6841, LINES=5321, SAMPLE_BITS=8, BANDS=3, FILTER_NAME='321, 415, 689', COORDINATE_SYSTEM_NAME=PLANETOCENTRIC. Coverage 70N-70S split into 8 tiles of 70 deg lat x 90 deg lon (E350N0450, E350S0450, E350N1350, ...). CAVEAT: the 3BAND .IMG file returned 404 (application/xml) while the 321NM .IMG returned 206 (145609920 B) — confirm the current .IMG naming per band before relying on a specific file. 8 tiles side by side give a ~27364 x 10642 equirectangular colour mosaic (derived, not vendor-stated).

licence: NASA public domain; SVS asks for credit; music is licensed third-party material in the narrated versions

Frame-extraction path: ffmpeg -i moontour_notitle_2160p30.mp4 -vf fps=1 out_%05d.png. NOT usable as a texture.

title: NASA SVS — Moon Phase and Libration, 2025 (ID 5415, current in the series)
description: Geocentric phase, libration, position angle and apparent diameter of the Moon for every hour of 2025. This is DISK-ON-SKY imagery (what the Moon looks like from Earth), not an equirectangular globe texture. The series is 4442 (2019), 4459 (2019 South Up), 4768 (2020), 4769 (2020 South Up), 4874 (2021), 5187 (2024), 5188 (2024 South Up), 5415 (2025).
projection: disk-on-sky (perspective view of the whole Moon), plus pre-rendered yearly videos
format: JPEG frame set (730x730) + 1920x1080 TIFF frames + MP4/MOV yearly animations + JSON/TXT ephemeris tables
credit: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio / Ernie Wright; scientific consulting Noah Petro; produced by James Tralie
licence: NASA public domain; SVS asks for credit
notes: Probe of the 2024 (5187) frame path: 206 image/jpeg total=89674 JPEG 730x730. Page text for both 5187 and 5415 advertises 'frames/730x730_1x1_30p/moon.0283.jpg (730x730)' and 'frames/1920x1080_16x9_60p/moon.0001.tif (1920x1080)'. IMPORTANT: the advertised 1920x1080 TIFF path returned 404 (text/html, 196 B) on 5187 — the page's own link is stale. Eight Dial-A-Moon stills per year are published as phase_*.NNNN.tif (e.g. 2020: https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/vis/a000000/a004700/a004768/phase_full.2347.tif; 2024 set under a005000/a005048/, one probed: phase_full.1571.tif -> 206 image/tiff total=9890006). Also mooninfo_YYYY.json / mooninfo_YYYY.txt ephemeris tables per year
